title: Procurement for the supply of 900,000 prefilled Syringes/Vials of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 4,000IU in 0.4ml
decision_details: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 900,000 prefilled Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 4,000IU, 0.4ml Syringes/Vials used for the treatment of patients with heart diseases. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s. Gland Pharma Limited, India (Manufacturer - M/s. Gland Pharma Limited, India) for a sum of USD 1.143 million, based on the recommendation of the Standing High‑Level Procurement Committee on the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
